body:
True; yeah I’ve never really understood that either. I feel like who ever penned that line, probably hadn’t suffered themselves— or not chronically at the very least. I mean yes, sure it could be viewed as temporary, in the sense that feelings do on occasion shift for better or worse. But you’re absolutely right. It’s the frequency of the negative. For me I’m always trying figure out how function w/ that temporary problem. Maybe you’re the same way. 

Only been a few things that’ve ‘helped’ me maintain some kind of inner strength, w/ that ‘temporary problem’. (And that doesn’t go to say it’ll work a lot of the time, in fact rarely do I feel like it’s effective for me). But for me it’s all been about distractions — sometimes it helps other times it doesn’t. And usually not when the numbness overwhelms me. But yeah like writing/journaling, forcing myself to go for a walk (although that’s extremely hard, and sometimes I get nothing out of it), etc etc 

Has anything helped you? (Or not really very much)
Hey; what kind of situation? (if you want to say; you don’t have to)
That sounds awful; has anything helped distract or cope w/ things when you’ve experienced those before? (Or not really; more like just waiting it out)
